sections.para: Technical artist who can author an asset and then fix the pipeline that exports it. Twelve shipped titles, three of them on Poki with more than 11 million players between them, and a Unity Asset Store publisher with five tools live. I write HLSL for URP, build the tooling a studio runs on, and make art hold up on a cheap Android — and I build the tool rather than repeat the task.

jobs.title: Technical Artist
bullets: Shipped **12 titles**: three on Poki — **Snake vs Human** (Nov 2025; 10M+ players, 4.5/5, most-played game of the Green Game Jam, also on Google Play and the App Store), **Harvest Loop** (1M+ players, 4.3/5) and **Butterfly Catch** (Nov 2026) — plus nine hyper-casual games on Google Play, among them Pizza Paws, Jam Drive Thru and Emoji Sort.
Led the performance work that gained roughly **200% more FPS on low-end Android**, across shader cost, draw calls, texture budgets and the asset-authoring rules that keep them down.

Authored every shader used across the studio's projects in HLSL and Shader Graph on URP, including the **13 ability VFX in Snake vs Human** at three upgrade tiers each, and own the documentation that lets other artists use them unaided.
Built and maintain **ArtToolkit** and **DuduTween**, shared Unity packages consumed by every game in the studio as Git submodules.
Built Unity editor tools in C# that attach VFX and swap textures straight from animation clips, taking a repetitive manual step out of the animation pipeline.
Work across Unity and plain HTML/JavaScript targets, maintaining the Unity import rules the rest of the art team follows.

jobs.title: Technical Artist / 3D Artist
bullets: **Yellow Panda** (2025 – present): environment art, props, UI and VFX for educational games, including **Pop&Play**, a multiplayer platformer, and **Libras em Ação**, a Brazilian sign-language game produced for the XReall initiative funded by Fapesc.
Game-ready props and characters delivered into Unity and Unreal Engine, with the shaders and materials each client's target look needed.
Documented a client's Unity UI build process so their team could carry it into later projects without me.

jobs.title: Mentor
bullets: Recurring technical-art mentorships for the UpLink programme: Unity, shaders, VFX, animation and optimisation, the 3D pipeline from sculpt to engine, what the role actually is inside a team, and portfolio and career direction.

jobs.title: 3D Artist
bullets: Props and characters for mobile hyper-casual games, implemented in engine with their VFX.

sections.para: Publishing Unity tools and shaders under my own name — assetstore.unity.com/publishers/142088.
bullets: **Live** — **Gizmos Drawer** (free; 27 editor gizmos in 7 categories, bound drag-and-drop to private fields, properties or ScriptableObject data), **Simple VAT** (2,500 characters with zero Animators: skinned animation baked to vertex textures and played on the GPU), **Scene Notes** (a PureRef-style reference board inside Unity, with Scene-view pins), **Gradient Atlas** and **Time Tracker**.
**In review** — Reference Hunter, Texture Workbench, SDF Baker and Curve Texture.

**In development** — nine more, including **Impostor Baker** (octahedral impostors as the last LOD: a 5,000-tree forest drops from 1.61M triangles to 86,276), **SimpleVAT Crowd** (20,000 characters from one component), **Sub Graph Library** (60 Shader Graph nodes for URP) and **Floating Numbers** (damage numbers for thousands of targets in two draw calls).
**VFXForge** — a node-based VFX texture and sprite-sheet tool in TypeScript, 81 nodes, with a Unity import package.
**Illustrator Color Wheel** — the hue ring and HSB triangle Illustrator never shipped, as a docked CEP panel.
**eduardo-fernandes-3d.github.io** — portfolio site written by hand, no framework; bilingual, light and dark.

row: **Associate Degree, Digital Games** — UNISO, Universidade de Sorocaba

paragraphs.t: Hello,

I'm a technical artist at Kreativitas Studio, working on mobile, web and VR games in Unity, plain HTML and Unreal. Three of them are live on Poki — Snake vs Human, Harvest Loop and Butterfly Catch — and nine more are on Google Play, most of which never got a full launch.
I've also worked on VR and Steam titles as a freelancer, doing 3D models, optimisation, VFX and materials.
My major accomplishments:

Twelve shipped games, three of them on Poki. Snake vs Human passed 10 million players and was the most-played game of the Green Game Jam; I was on it from the first prototype and helped shape its concept and design.
Optimisation work that gained around 200% more FPS on low-end Android, and the port that took the original game from Android to web.
Conceptualised and built a large body of VFX, shaders and technical animation across every game I've worked on.
Tools that other artists and level designers use daily, including our own tween library built to fit the studio's needs, a custom atlas creator, and a UI system reusable on every project.
Mentoring artists into the industry at Casulo Indie · UpLink.
Tools published on the Unity Asset Store, including Simple VAT, which I wrote to cut the number of skinned meshes in web games.

I came into technical art from 3D — Maya, ZBrush, Substance, Photoshop — so I can author an asset and then fix the pipeline that exports it. Knowing the pipeline is also what makes it easy to see where it can be improved, which is why I keep building tools, for myself and for others, to take the repetition out of the work. AI is a big part of that pipeline now: mostly ChatGPT for concepts and sketching ideas, and Claude Code for coding and for building the tools that save me time.
I'm based in Brazil and looking for remote work. My portfolio is at eduardo-fernandes-3d.github.io, and I'd be glad to walk you through any of it.
Thanks for reading,
Eduardo

row: **Tecnólogo em Jogos Digitais** — UNISO, Universidade de Sorocaba

paragraphs.t: Olá,

Sou artista técnico na Kreativitas Studio, trabalhando em jogos mobile, web e VR, em Unity, HTML puro e Unreal. Três deles estão no ar na Poki — Snake vs Human, Harvest Loop e Butterfly Catch — e outros nove estão na Google Play, a maioria sem nunca ter tido um lançamento completo.
Também trabalhei em jogos de VR e de Steam como freelancer, fazendo modelos 3D, otimização, VFX e materiais.
Minhas principais conquistas:

Doze jogos publicados, três deles na Poki. O Snake vs Human passou de 10 milhões de jogadores e foi o jogo mais jogado da Green Game Jam; estive nele desde o primeiro protótipo e ajudei a moldar seu conceito e seu design.
Trabalho de otimização que rendeu cerca de 200% mais FPS em aparelhos Android low-end, e a conversão que levou o jogo original de Android para web.
Concebi e criei um grande volume de VFX, shaders e animação técnica em todos os jogos em que trabalhei.

Ferramentas que outros artistas e level designers usam no dia a dia, incluindo nossa própria biblioteca de tween feita sob medida para o estúdio, um criador de atlas customizado e um sistema de UI reaproveitável em qualquer projeto.
Mentoria para artistas entrarem na indústria, na Casulo Indie · UpLink.
Ferramentas publicadas na Unity Asset Store, entre elas o Simple VAT, que escrevi para reduzir a quantidade de skinned meshes em jogos web.

Cheguei à arte técnica a partir do 3D — Maya, ZBrush, Substance, Photoshop — então consigo modelar o asset e também arrumar o pipeline que o exporta. Conhecer o pipeline é também o que torna fácil enxergar onde ele pode melhorar, e é por isso que sigo construindo ferramentas, para mim e para os outros, para tirar a repetição do trabalho. IA hoje é uma parte grande desse pipeline: uso principalmente o ChatGPT para conceitos e para esboçar ideias, e o Claude Code para programar e para desenvolver as ferramentas que me poupam tempo.
Moro no Brasil e procuro trabalho remoto. Meu portfólio está em eduardo-fernandes-3d.github.io, e fico à disposição para mostrar qualquer parte dele.
Obrigado pela leitura,
Eduardo
